Every colour comes from [`palette/zacess.json`](https://github.com/zacesshq/themes/blob/v0.12.1/palette/zacess.json). This table is written from
it by `scripts/build.mjs`, so it always matches the themes. Each role keeps its font style in every
theme, so a token never relies on colour alone. The interface, terminal and colour vision values are
in [ACCESSIBILITY.md](https://github.com/zacesshq/themes/blob/v0.12.1/ACCESSIBILITY.md).
